frame_definition: books: visible && pages_count>0 && no translated pages (pages_translated absent/null/<=0) && language group != English (any books.language containing "english", or en/eng, excluded)
unit: work (books.work_id; a book without work_id is its own work); one random book per drawn work

estimator.headline: no_prior_known share of drawn works per stratum (all verdicts in the denominator except could_not_search, which is retried and reported separately)
estimator.works: stratum rate × stratum frame works; corpus total = Σ_h W_h p_h; Wilson 95% per stratum; corpus CI from Σ W_h² p(1−p)/n_h × fpc
estimator.books: ratio estimator per stratum (Σ y_i m_i / Σ m_i, m_i = the work's books in the stratum frame) × stratum frame books; 95% CI by stratified bootstrap (2,000 reps, seed 7651)
estimator.period: post-stratified by the drawn book's edition-year bucket, each drawn work weighted W_h/n_h; bootstrap CI; cells with n<10 marked thin

controls_rule: reviewed card status prior_exists with a verified, complete, cited entry; untranslated books preferred; one per work; blind in the run order
rejudge_rule: 20 random sample ids re-judged by an independent second pass (fresh process, different model, never shown the first verdict)
